fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-10-22, the complainant was allegedly assaulted during an argument near Vaigai Layout Market Road, resulting in minor injuries. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-10-22 at about 19:35. A further person, Arun Muthu, a relative of the suspect, using the number 9000000304, is stated to be associated with the incident. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complainant alleged that Karthik Velan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000188. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Dispute reportedly escalated into a physical altercation.
